reviews.author: T Ben
reviews.text: I recently used Generals Tree Service to have a MONSTROUS pine tree trimmed in my front yard. I am EXTREMELY pleased with the result. They are professional and efficient and it didn't take that long because Gil brings a crew of very kind, very professional people with him. They did an OUTSTANDING JOB! My pine MONSTER, actually looks like a beautiful tree again! Their rates are very good for all the work they do and they cleaned up my yard afterwards beautifully! If you are wondering whether to use this company for any tree trimming or removal services, do not hesitate! You will not be sorry!
